place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: Went here at 10pm. Place looks cozy and nice. We sat outside. Service was good. Food could be better. The shakshuka doesn't taste like shakshuka at all. Doesn't have the necessary spice it needs. It just taste like pork and beans, too sweet. Creamy chicken lacks flavor too, I thought that was their best seller because my friend recommended it. Chicken was not crunchy and meat was a bit dry. She said it was good when they went there before at 3am. Maybe kitchen was overwhelmed because it was a bit busy. Try it yourself maybe it was just our experience. 3 cheese quesadilla/pizza my friend orderd, she said is really good and worth it. I'll try it next time. Probably will come back there for a morning coffee and chill since the place has a nice ambiance.

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: One of the best place to go. Went here 7PM on a Monday. I was with my girlfriend. We just saw this from a review video on facebook. First, the Food is great but not the perfect type for 5 star but at least it is a 4 star. Second is the service is great and amazing. We were greeted, presented to our table, and given water. The staffs are easy to call on to, they also served the food earlier than usual. Third the atmosphere, this was one of the best place since the ambiance suits to whatever mood you may have, romantic or serious or chilling. Just amazing

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina

review_text: Honestly, the food and vibe were both great. What stood out was how attentive the service was. They genuinely made sure every customer felt seen, and the wait wasn't bad at all for a bistro. The one thing that could use improvement? Managing the flies around the dining area.

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: Service attendant was courteous. Food flavor was adequate except for the fish dish that had tough portions, may have been overcooked. Salad was served a little after the main dish when it was requested to be served first. Business owner needs to do housekeeping of restaurant debris/construction matetials in service and parking areas.

review_text: The creamy beef is perfect. Worth the price and taste. The pork lechon kawali is barely a single serving for the price of 5-6 pax. The 190php rice bundle is not worth it. It's only worth 2-3. It would be better to order ala carte. The drinks are superb. Worth a second visit.

review_text: Cozy.. A place where you can chill-out and release tensions and stress. With wonderful foods and delightful beverages like coffees and tea, truly brings-out the lake by the garden natures healing prowess. 🍵 ☕ 🍲 🥘 🍜 🍗 🧆 🍃 🍀 🌿 🌳

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: The serving time was surprisingly fast. Food was good I ordered pasta and was filling. Overall experience was great. Only concern was maybe there would be mosquitos due to the lake outside.

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: Ambiance: The place is really nice with a great layout. You have the choice between a cool air-conditioned indoor area or a breezy alfresco space. One tip: if you choose the alfresco, be prepared for some mosquitoes! Food: The food is good and definitely worth the price. While it didn't completely blow me away, everything was well-prepared and satisfying for a meal out. Service: Very positive experience with the crew. They are accommodating and attentive. Overall: A solid spot for a meal, especially if you enjoy garden-style dining. Just bring some repellent if you're sitting outside!

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: Located on the lot of Garden Fresca. Lemon peach (sparkling water) and aglio olio pasta were savory. Plates I took home were just okay taste-wise (see photos). Rates were higher but each dish was generally for 3-4 pax. Ask the waiter for a wifi voucher which covers only 2 hours. More vouchers should be given for those who spent 3k above. Complainits: - air-conditioning was warm (FAN mode is more appropriate) - annoying flies hovering while eating - staff - noisy (chitchatting) - continuous coughing/sneezing of lady cashier - inattentive waiter with my takeout order instructions (had to wait for another hour) - frozen lettuce leaves hidden under on both the garden and waldorf salads - sucks that there's a service charge for debit card (3%) and P15 for gcash (gotyme) There you have it. I won't be coming back. However, I'm still hoping Management will improve on those stated above for the sake of future customers.

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: It was a wonderful dining experience made special by the very accommodating staff.

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: I wish I could give more stars! Impeccable customer service from chat to dine, excellent food and generous serving. Everyone was welcoming, even the security guard who accommodated us when we arrived. Servers had great smiles on their faces. Perhaps more lights on the river would be an upgrade since the atmosphere was cozy. Huge thanks to the social media manager who was very patient and recommended tasty foods despite some items not being available. My favorite dish was the pesto pasta and the mango quesadilla. It was such a promising dish, though I wish it was a pizza rather than a quesadilla. Not really a fan of quesadillas here in Davao. Hopefully soon, pizzas can take over the quesadillas because I could barely taste the cheese but I enjoyed it.

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: The serving took a long time. We waited for more than an hour. The food wasn't served all at once. They served it on a different time that you have to consume it first, and your companion will eat later than you did. This means you can not enjoy the food at the same time. My baby back ribs was served cold, and when I started savoring it. It was hard, and it seemed like it was a leftover that was heated. All in all, my experience was not good.

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: Nice restaurant in the metro. We came here for lunch and everything was delicious! Crispy pata, sinigang sa mangga and manggo quesidilla was all great! Service was very good too. Highly recommended when visiting davao

review_text: An Honest Review JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant in their MATINA BRANCH is open 24hrs EVERYDAY My husband and I went 4 AM on a Sunday to avoid the crowd and to experience an early breakfast with the sun rising. This experience was so amazing. I kid you not. Now let's talk about the food. Coffee was really good. I had Cappuccino and Hubby got Caramel Macchiato. CM was so so but Cappuccino was UHMMM 🤌🏽 For Mains we got Baby Bach Ribs and Sizzling Steak Ala Pobre. Hubby said Steak was Good 8/10 . I loved my Baby Back Rib this melts on your mouth, The only thing I really don't like is the amount of fat that was still attached on the rib. I'm not a fan of beef fat. So this for me is 8/10. Next is the Sweet Keso Pizzadilla. This one was 100/10. I was shocked since it was served with garlic on top, but to my surprise it was not overpowering at all. Caramelized garlic was so good with cheese. This is a must try. We don't have the chance to order their pasta because we're so full. STAFF. 10/10. All of them must have been awake all night but greeted us with smiling faces. After ordering and getting our table they quickly served us service water and told us that coffee will be served in a while. I really love this place. It is peaceful. Good for serene date nights with deep talks. 👍🏻 MUST VISIT

review_text: We went there for a quick late lunch. We were told that our orders will be out in 20 minutes, but we waited more than the time promised. Service water and utensils were given (but no disposable napkins at all). Initial food served was tropical mango (not warm enough) and pesto pasta. We had to wait for a few minutes again for the rest of the orders before we can actually start eating together. We expected that the tuna dish comes with a side dish of salad as what was promoted on their menu, but to our surprise they said that it's unavailable. Some portions of tuna served was undercooked. We waited if tissue was gonna get serve by the time we were already eating but it never came. (We also observed that the other guest from another table had to go to the counter and ask for tissue). If you will pay using your credit card, they will charge you 3% on top of your total bill. Overall, it's a fair enough first (and probably last) visit.

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: The place is pleasantly located in Coca-Cola Village in the bustling area of Matina. This charming bistro offers a serene escape with its beautiful garden-themed ambiance and warm, inviting atmosphere. The food is both delicious and affordable. We tried their best-selling Sweet Keso Quesadilla as our side. For our mains, we had the Sizzling Steak Ala Pobre, and Pasayan Espesyal. The Nutella Hazelnut frappe was also a nice touch of mix-and-matching two flavors that most people know and resulted in a surprisingly new flavor that I can't explain, so you should try it. Despite its low ratings, our experience at JH Garden Cafe was exceptional. The food was served promptly, and the staff was friendly and attentive. Perhaps the lack of reviews can be attributed to the fact that we visited during a less crowded time. One thing for sure though is that this place is not your typical fast-food chain where you just need to line up and have your order assembled in front of you at the counter. No, they prep your food within the required amount of time for your satisfaction so this should be a good heads up for fractious individuals not to come here. Overall, if you're looking for a peaceful place to unwind, enjoy good food, and spend quality time with loved ones, JH Garden Cafe is a highly recommended place.

place_name: JH Garden Cafe and Restaurant Matina
review_text: Nice place and ambiance. The outside seating facing a pond was a good place to relax in the late afternoon. The staff was very accommodating. The food however was so-so. The pomelo lychee salad had a very sweet dressing. A more tangy dressing would have worked better. The pepper beef was not peppery but very creamy, almost like a stroganoff. The tonkatsu was ok but the sauce is like the ready-made packed sauces in the grocery. The garlic parmesan chicken had a very soft and chewy crust... probably flour and egg was used for the batter. The iced tea drinks were also very sweet. May eat here again if there are limited options but will not recommend.
